catalog.text:
Draft deterministic equity constitution, version 1.
Evaluate each completed bar once in input order. Prices and cash are integer cents; quantities are whole shares. Orders fill fully at that bar's close with zero fees and slippage. Missing or nonpositive prices suppress that symbol's actions. Indicators require their full window of observed prices. Sells precede buys within a strategy; no same-bar re-entry. Each strategy owns private lots even when symbols overlap. Sibling order is the declared slot order; insufficient cash skips the entire purchase. Strategies complete after one full round trip. Partial exits sell at least one share. Parallel completes when all children complete. Sequence activates its next child on the following bar. Race assigns ownership to the first subtree that actually buys, with declared order breaking ties. A state gate blocks new entries while false but continues exits. An event gate opens once and remains open. Reset liquidates all owned lots when every held symbol has a price, clears subtree state, and permits reactivation on the next bar. Reset takes priority over ordinary actions. No implicit end-of-data liquidation. These rules must be reviewed before a counted study; they do not model partial fills, margin, shorts, options, fees, or live execution.

Implement the following strategy tree as class FrozenBenchmark(QCAlgorithm) in QuantConnect LEAN Python. Follow the response format in the execution appendix. Submit native market orders with each order tag exactly <compiled strategy path>|buy, |sell or |reset. The execution appendix supplies compiled paths, UTC bar-close timestamps and integer-cent inputs. Grading reads actual engine OrderEvents and order tags; printed or logged traces do not count as fills.

{{slot:strategy}}
catalog.state: Integer-cents shared cash and per-node private whole-share lots.
tests: Flat, shared-symbol, nested sequence/race, gates, reset, cash-contention, missing-price and mutation controls.

conditions.label: Local Claude CLI, non-interactive print mode

protocol.selection: All frozen tasks; first completed attempt. Transport failures alone may retry.
protocol.stopping: Stop at the fixed attempt or elapsed-time budget.
protocol.analysis: Per-condition scores over completed trials; report scheduled, failed, interrupted, and pending counts separately.

environment.instructions: Apparatus-development run. The pinned LEAN image digest is present locally; `docker image inspect` resolves it. Python 3.10 or later generates the deterministic minute files. No counted study is authorized by this project.

analysisPlan.rationale: Apparatus-development computations on one task. The purpose is to exercise the compile/collect/native-grade/report path end to end and show every step, not to measure a model. One task and one replicate cannot support an interval, a contrast or any inference about a provider; the per-condition rates below are descriptions of three single trials.

spec.decisions: Apparatus-development cohort. The catalog carries a synthetic marker in place of a personal review; no bundle has been reviewed by a person and no counted study is authorized. Three conditions exercise three different response origins against the same frozen prompt: the starter’s recorded canary, a trusted generated reference program, and the local Claude CLI. Native grading reads engine OrderEvents, never printed traces.
